provenance.note: SIM scenario profile, not a device specification. No paired model, no hardware evidence, calibration unknown. No catalog source (NASA-SOURCES.md, sources.csv, nasa-data) and no repository source sets a device range or rate limit for this family, so range_min, range_max and max_rate_per_second stay null: missing stays missing (AGENTS.md section 1 rule 5). Each reading then carries unchecked:range:<code> and unchecked:rate:<code> quality notes, and a real profile sets them from the paired device's instructions for use (evidence_ref). irregular_pulse is noted, not rejecting, because how an automated cuff behaves during an irregular rhythm is unsourced (docs/product/DEMO-CONDITIONS.md kit table, C04, C05).

provenance.path: Bluetooth SIG Blood Pressure Service 0x1810, Blood Pressure Measurement 0x2A35
provenance.note: completion measurement: each Blood Pressure Measurement (0x2A35) indication is one complete measurement (Bluetooth SIG Blood Pressure Service specification), so the device ending its connection after it is the normal end of a reading, not a lost one. A source that never delivered a measurement still fails.

NASA CHP-IDSP Project Updates (HRP IWS 2025, NTRS 20250000330): heart rate, blood pressure, temperature and blood oxygen levels are collected data packaged as the crew member's patient file. Why the kit reading is kept as attributed device data.
Bounds are data checks, not clinical thresholds (validation text of the measurement fields).
Blood pressure panel: LOINC 85354-9 with 8480-6 systolic and 8462-4 diastolic (SYSTEM 7.3); indicator codes systolic_bp and diastolic_bp in mm[Hg] (D12, docs/product/CONTRACTS.md:86).
